Donald Trump looked our troops, our families, and our nation in the eye and promised to end the forever wars. Now his reckless war in Iran rages on without an end in sight: American servicemembers have been killed, hundreds more wounded, prices are skyrocketing, and there is still no plan for peace. We must end this illegal war now.
